topics.headline: Both US CPI and Eurozone HICP set to decelerate, not accelerate
topics.summary: Eurozone HICP already confirmed at 2.8% in June, down from 3.2% in May, and US consensus (FactSet, Goldman, Natixis, Cleveland Fed Nowcast) overwhelmingly points to June CPI easing to ~3.9% from 4.2% on falling gas prices—making simultaneous acceleration in both highly unlikely this cycle.

topics.headline: HY spreads near historic tights, but asymmetric widening risk builds
topics.summary: At ~2.7% OAS, high-yield spreads sit near 20-year lows even as record AI-driven bond issuance (Amazon's $25B deal, Oracle's downgrade toward junk) and strategist warnings from State Street and Schwab suggest limited room for further compression and higher odds of widening over the next 30 days.

topics.headline: Bitcoin ETF inflow rebound looks fragile amid Fed and Iran risk
topics.summary: A single $197.4M inflow week snapped an eight-week, $8.26B outflow streak, but BTC's drop toward $62K on Iran tensions, hawkish Fed minutes ahead of July 28-29, and thin volumes suggest this is more likely a pause than a reversal—analysts say a second consecutive inflow week is the real signal to watch.

topics.headline: VIX spikes 13.7% to 17.09 on Middle East oil supply fears
topics.summary: Fighting near the Strait of Hormuz pushed oil and the VIX sharply higher, but VIX's strong mean-reversion tendency and the fact that 17.09 remains within its 3-month range suggest the spike may fade unless geopolitical or CPI-driven shocks persist over the next 30 days.

topics.headline: Microsoft-Chevron 20-year Texas PPA headlines new hyperscaler power deal wave
topics.summary: Microsoft signed a 20-year, 2 GW co-located gas PPA with Chevron's Energy Forge One in Pecos, Texas, and bought 2.7 GW of GE Vernova turbines, extending a pattern of gigawatt-scale hyperscaler power deals (Meta-TerraPower/Oklo/Vistra, Google-Clearway) that easily satisfies this question within any 30-day window.
